public/capabilities.json:
{
  "identity": "trade-journal-d2-v1",
  "scope": "Exact Long Stock planning and one complete initial buy decision, with Position Change Reflection and Journal-only Debt resolution",
  "operations": {
    "Workspace": [
      "initialize",
      "getStatus",
      "requestDurability"
    ],
    "ReferenceCatalog": [
      "save.CreateInstitution",
      "save.CreateAccount",
      "query.Strategy",
      "query.Institution",
      "query.Account",
      "resolve.NewSelection",
      "resolve.DisplayOnly",
      "resolve.RetainedReference"
    ],
    "TradeWorkflows": [
      "confirmPlan",
      "recordPositionChange.InitialStockEntry"
    ],
    "TradeAnalysis": [
      "assessPlan.LongStock",
      "derive.Planned",
      "derive.OpenStock",
      "assessChange.InitialStockEntry"
    ],
    "TradeRecord": [
      "prepareChange.ConfirmPlan",
      "applyPreparedChange.ConfirmPlan",
      "getRecord",
      "queryRecords.Planned",
      "history",
      "resolveAnchors.Trade",
      "prepareChange.InitialStockEntry",
      "applyPreparedChange.InitialStockEntry",
      "queryRecords.Open",
      "resolveAnchors.Execution"
    ],
    "Journal": [
      "getDefinitions.PlanReflection",
      "prepareEffects.PlanReflection",
      "applyPreparedEffects.PlanReflection",
      "query.TradeNarrative",
      "getDefinitions.PositionChangeReflection",
      "prepareEffects.PositionChangeReflection",
      "applyPreparedEffects.PositionChangeReflection",
      "query.ObligationsAndDebt",
      "save.ResolveJournalOnlyDebt"
    ],
    "TradeViewsAndReporting": [
      "browseTrades.Planned",
      "getTradeDetail.Planned",
      "browseTrades.Open",
      "getTradeDetail.Open"
    ]
  },
  "backupSchemaRanges": [],
  "providerAdapters": [],
  "calendarPolicy": {
    "approvedRange": [
      "2021-01-01",
      "2028-12-31"
    ],
    "installedSessionOperations": []
  },
  "workspaceSchemas": {
    "current": 2,
    "supportedMigrationSources": [
      1
    ]
  }
}
